paragraphs.text:
You and Norman take to your heels. The panicked herds crash 
through the grass behind you, gaining fast. You will never make 
it to the woods.

Make an INT roll: if you succeed, go to 323; if you fail, the stampede 
rolls over both of you, inflicting 4D6 damage to each of you. If you 
somehow survive, go to 347. Otherwise, the Nadelmann Expedition 
is over. THE END.
